name: local-cloud-console
description: A self-hosted EC2-style console for real Multipass virtual machines.

scripts.build: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm run test --workspaces
